name: Intent / Knowledge / Question
description: Caller asked a general product, fee, APR, rewards-program-rules, application, policy, or credit-education question needing no account access.

llm_configuration.context: Apply when the customer asks about product benefits, annual fees, APRs, how the rewards program works, eligibility/applications, company policies, or general credit education. Do not apply when the question is about the caller's own account, card, or points.
